title: The Den Investors
heading: The Den: the panel, the pitchers and the room
intro: Five investors in the den, all invented people (no lookalikes). Same room, same light, so they cut together. Pick one per investor; a note on any row gets a new round for that one.

sections.lede: Script agreed. One pick per shot; the investors' reactions start from your locked panel stills.

groups.title: 1. The minister comes down
groups.line: Down the real stairs (your pick), already smiling.

groups.title: 2. The minister pitches
groups.line: On the mark; he speaks here (lip-sync wants the face big).

opts.label: MIN-b
opts.warn: standing, good; face a bit small for lip-sync

opts.label: MIN-a
opts.warn: looks seated among the chairs, not standing on the mark

groups.title: 6. The nurse pitches
groups.line: Same mark and framing as the minister.

groups.title: 5. The panel ("I'm out")
groups.line: All five in the room. Masks are tiny at this size.

sections.lede: Set: your window-loft pick as the room; chairs and cash from the brief.

groups.title: Investor A
groups.line: Early sixties, grey crop, half-moon glasses on a chain, burgundy suit. Unimpressed.

groups.title: Investor B
groups.line: Late forties, neat beard, navy three-piece. Fingertips together, cold smile.

groups.title: Investor C
groups.line: About seventy, bald, mustard cardigan, knitted tie. Leaning in, blunt.

groups.title: Investor D
groups.line: Mid thirties, black bob, polo-neck, tablet. Already bored.

groups.title: BadCode
groups.line: In the balaclava. Two fix passes: the triangle now points down; placement is upper-centre, not quite 2 o'clock. d is closest.
